acceptanceCriteria: A pack case path (under <pack>/fixtures/<slug>/(violating|passing)/<case>/ with a pack.json) is dropped by verify, serve and the L3 hooks (file list and added lines) and by every size rule incl. core/max-file-bytes
Every other fixtureGlobs path (testdata/, fixtures/ without a pack) stays judged by every rule; fixtureGlobs only relaxes secret detection
Editing a pack case.json holding marker text that core/no-assertion-loss flags, or over 1 MiB, is not blocked by the pre-commit hook
diagnosis: Reproduced: staging a pack case.json over 1 MiB blocks pre-commit with core/max-file-bytes, and verify drops testdata/danger.sh. Root cause: sizes.ts exempts isFixturePath from every size rule except max-file-bytes and git-hook/gate-scope pass pack case files and diff hunks to rules, while cli/evaluate.ts withoutFixtures and serve-eval.ts drop every default fixture glob path (testdata/, fixtures/) for every rule, on the false assumption that all fixture-glob paths are pack self-test data. SPEC 4.4.1 now confines the exemption to pack case data.
